description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the SubscriptionManager class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.search package. It uses Akka actor testing and JUnit to verify subscription behaviors such as creation, handling of invalid parameters, parallel sessions, and message exchanges.

classes.name: SubscriptionManagerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the SubscriptionManager, verifying core subscription functionalities and behaviors using Akka TestKit and JUnit.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes actor system, materializer, and test probes before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the actor system after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: noSuchSubscription
methods.description: Tests the behavior when requesting a non-existent subscription, expecting a SubscriptionFailed message.

methods.name: illegalPageSize
methods.description: Tests creation of a subscription with an illegal page size, expecting a SubscriptionFailed message.

methods.name: illegalDemand
methods.description: Tests requesting with an invalid demand (zero), expecting a SubscriptionFailed message.

methods.name: parallelSessions
methods.description: Tests concurrent subscriptions and message exchanges, ensuring correct behavior across multiple sessions and error handling.

methods.description: Helper method to create SubscriptionComplete messages for tests.
